Established in 1924, the independent family-owned business LKW WALTER is the leading transport organisation for full truck loads.

Irrespective of the location of our customers, we organise full truck loads ...

... throughout Europe
... from all European countries to Russia, Central Asia, North Africa and vice versa
... as well as national transport in individual EU countries.

Our customers - major international companies, as well as medium and small sized enterprises across Europe - place more than 5,500 orders for full truck loads (FTL) with us daily.

The Kubota Info App is a simple way to obtain information about Kubota engines and is available for free on your mobile device.
You can filter engine information according to your requirement and easily browse catalog information for engines that you are using or interested in.
In addition, information about Kubota engines, such as events and news, will be delivered to you.  You will be kept updated  about Kubota engines and relevant events, such as exhibitions. Stay tuned and connected with Kubota!


Key Features
(1) Receive up-to-date information of Kubota Engines
With push notifications, you can get the latest information on new products, events, and more about Kubota Engines.
(2) Browse an engine specifications
You can see the details of engine specifications in this app.  In addition, images are also available, so you can grasp the shape of the engine.
(3) Download the detailed PDF of engine specifications
With this app, engine specifications and external drawings can be downloaded in PDF format.  Those downloaded PDFs can be viewed offline. The downloaded PDF will be shown in the download list.
(4) Filtering from various conditions
You can search for an engine by various conditions, such as power range and emission level. You will quickly find an engine you are looking for. 
(5) Register your engine as a favorite.
You can bookmark the engine you like with this app.  Bookmarked engines are displayed in the favorites list.  You can also delete from the list by dropping the bookmark.

(6) Find the nearest Kubota Engine Sales Company
You can find the nearest Kubota Engine Sales company from the latest store list.
